extracted.name: Tuna tartare
extracted.description: Serve this vibrant tuna dish as a starter or light lunch. As you aren’t cooking the fish, you’ll need to use the highest quality (sashimi-grade) tuna
ingredient_lines: 400g sashimi-grade yellow fin tuna block or steak
thumb-sized piece of ginger finely grated
1 red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of coriander leaves picked and roughly chopped, stalks finely chopped
1 lime juiced, plus extra wedges to serve
toasted bread or ciabatta slices, to serve
instruction_lines: Cut the tuna into 1cm chunks, then put in the fridge to keep chilled while you make the sauce.

Combine the ginger, garlic, chilli, most of the coriander leaves and all the stalks, the lime juice, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and sesame seeds in a large bowl. If you like, add extra lime juice to taste. Tip in the tuna chunks and mix well to coat.

Spoon the tuna mixture into shallow bowls or press into a mound using a cooking ring for a neat shape. Sprinkle over the remaining coriander leaves, then serve with bread or ciabatta toasts on the side.
